reviews.name: Anna Pieczonka - No Limit Mama
reviews.text: Girls, if you’re looking for someone who will make your dream nails and at the same time make you feel a bit better, you really need to visit Kasia. Going to her is not just a normal, stiff appointment. It’s more like meeting a really lovely, warm woman who simply has a heart of gold. I really appreciate that Kasia always looks at the condition of your nails at the time of the appointment. She doesn’t just do the same thing every time. She knows how to advise you what base or care will be best for your nails at that moment, so they stay healthy and safe. And the result? My nails hold up like crazy. Nothing comes off and they stay looking good for weeks. I always leave with beautiful nails, but also with a lot of good advice — from cuticles to life advice. And I love that Kasia is always learning and improving. She goes to trainings and courses all the time, so every time there is something new. The atmosphere is just great, no stress, no awkwardness, just good girl energy. I honestly really recommend her. Once you go, you’ll understand what I mean.

reviews.name: Paulina Trojanowska
reviews.text: I’m really happy with my nails! ❤️ Everything was done so carefully and the final result is beautiful. The whole appointment was really nice and relaxed, and I felt very comfortable. 😊 I’ll definitely be coming back and I can honestly recommend her! 💅❤️

reviews.name: Agnieszka
reviews.text: Bardzo polecam.zawsze wychodzę z idealną stylizacją.Kasia jest dokładna, i bardzo zaangażowana w to co robi. Dodatkowo jest bardzo sympatyczna i zawsze jest miła atmosfera:)
